mapper.sql: m.ID AS id, m.Nombre AS nombre, m.Apellidos AS apellidos, m.Password AS password, m.PasswordHashV2 AS passwordHashV2, m.PasswordHashV2Origen AS passwordHashV2Origen, m.LoginFallidosV2 AS loginFallidosV2, m.BloqueadoHastaV2 AS bloqueadoHastaV2, m.Activo AS activo, m.Confirmado AS confirmado
mapper.select: SELECT FROM medicos m WHERE m.Email = #{email} AND m.ID IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE medicos SET PasswordHashV2 = #{hash}, PasswordHashV2Origen = #{origen} WHERE ID = #{id}

UPDATE medicos SET LoginFallidosV2 = CASE WHEN BloqueadoHastaV2 IS NOT NULL AND BloqueadoHastaV2 <= #{ahora} THEN 1 ELSE COALESCE(LoginFallidosV2, 0) + 1 END, BloqueadoHastaV2 = CASE WHEN LoginFallidosV2 >= #{maxIntentos} THEN #{bloqueadoHasta} WHEN BloqueadoHastaV2 IS NOT NULL AND BloqueadoHastaV2 <= #{ahora} THEN NULL ELSE BloqueadoHastaV2 END WHERE ID = #{id}
UPDATE medicos SET LoginFallidosV2 = 0, BloqueadoHastaV2 = NULL WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT s.IdServicio AS id, s.Nombre AS nombre FROM guardias_servicios_medicos sm JOIN guardias_servicios s ON s.IdServicio = sm.IdServicio WHERE sm.IdMedico = #{medicoId} AND sm.IsAdministrator = 1 ORDER BY s.Nombre
